# Clivik Digital Solutions

> WhatsApp lead automation, customer review automation, and conversion-focused websites for local businesses.

## About
Clivik Digital Solutions is a digital growth and automation agency based in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India. Founded by Arjit Gupta, Clivik helps local and lead-driven businesses capture, qualify, follow up with, and convert customers using automated WhatsApp communication, Google review automation, and modern web development.

## Core Services
- WhatsApp Lead Qualification: 24/7 automated qualification of inbound inquiries that filters serious buyers and schedules appointments without human delay.
- Automated Lead Follow-Up: Multi-step conversational follow-ups on WhatsApp that re-engage prospects who did not buy or schedule on their first contact.
- WhatsApp Marketing: Targeted broadcast campaigns, customer retention sequences, and promotional messaging with high open and response rates.
- Customer Review Automation: Automated post-service review collection sent via WhatsApp directing satisfied clients to Google Maps profiles to build local SEO authority.
- Website Development: Fast, custom-built, mobile-optimized websites delivered within 5 to 7 days, complete with WhatsApp click-to-chat and lead capture forms.

## Target Customers
Local businesses and lead-driven enterprises, including:
- Healthcare & Dental Clinics
- Restaurants, Cafes & Dining Outlets
- Gyms & Fitness Centers
- Real Estate Consultants & Property Firms
- Local Retail Stores & Professional Service Providers
